footer.demo: Demo version · all data is fake and stays in your browser

auth.sideTitle: Find a field. Pick your eight. Play.
auth.sideText: Book a slot, challenge another team and see every result, all in one place.
auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to manage your teams and games.
auth.registerSubtitle: It takes less than a minute.

lineup.notEnough: This team has fewer than {n} players. Invite more friends to join!

match.invitedText: {team} invited you to this game. Pick your 8 players to accept.
match.adminNotFinished: You can enter the score after the game ends.
match.adminScoreText: The game is over. Enter the final score.
match.confirmedOwnerText: The game is on! You can still cancel before kick-off.
match.lineupPending: The lineup will appear when the invitation is accepted.
match.acceptText: Choose the {n} players who will play this game.
match.declineText: {team} will be told that you can't play. The slot becomes free again.
match.cancelText: Both teams will see the game as cancelled, and the slot becomes free again.
match.accepted: Game confirmed! See you on the pitch ⚽

home.heroTitle: Your next game is one tap away
home.heroText: Book a field, pick your eight players and challenge any team in the city.
home.step1Text: Create a team and invite your friends. Any squad size is fine.
home.step2Text: Pick a field, a day and one of nine 90-minute slots.
home.step3Text: Invite an opponent, choose your eight, and play. The result is saved after the game.
home.noUpcomingText: Book a field and challenge another team.

teams.subtitle: Find a team to join, or create your own.
teams.noneText: Try another search, or create a new team.
teams.createSubtitle: You will be the captain. Friends can join you afterwards.
teams.created: {name} was created. You are the captain!
teams.needPlayers: You need at least {n} players to play a game. You have {have} now.
teams.deleteText: {name} and all its games will be deleted. This can't be undone.
teams.kickText: {name} will be removed from the squad.

fields.subtitle: Every field hosts 8 vs 8 games in 90-minute slots.
fields.bookingText: Choose a free slot, then pick your opponent and lineup.
fields.paymentNote: Payment is made at the field. The slot is held while the other team decides.

book.title: Book a game
book.subtitle: Four quick steps and your invitation is on its way.
book.missingTitle: Choose a field and time first
book.missingText: Open a field and pick a free slot to start booking.
book.noTeamTitle: You don't own a team yet
book.noTeamText: Only team owners can book games. Create a team first.
book.chooseTeamText: You can book for teams you own.
book.chooseOpponent: Who do you want to play against?
book.chooseOpponentText: They will have 5 hours to accept.
book.chooseLineupText: Only these players will play. You can't pick the same person twice.
book.expiryNote: The slot is held for 5 hours. If the other team doesn't answer in time, the invitation expires.

matches.subtitle: Every game in Matchday, from invitations to final scores.
matches.noneText: Book a field and challenge a team to get things going.

invitations.subtitle: Challenges waiting for an answer.
invitations.noneReceivedText: When another team challenges yours, it will show up here.
invitations.noneSentText: Book a field and invite a team to play.
invitations.note: Invitations expire 5 hours after they are sent. A team can only have one invitation waiting at a time.

profile.resetText: All changes you made in this demo will be lost, and the sample data will be restored.
profile.noTeams: You're not in a team yet
profile.noTeamsText: Join a team or create your own.
profile.noMatches: You haven't played any games yet

admin.subtitle: Manage fields and enter results.
admin.waitingText: These games are over. Enter the final result.
admin.allDoneText: There are no finished games without a result.
admin.deleteFieldText: {name} and its games will be deleted.
